_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); cable signals

pit_profile.why: 'We are the largest cable operator in the United States' (FY2006 10-K, Item 1); 'We operate our businesses in an increasingly competitive environment' against DBS providers, phone companies 'that are building wireline fiber-optic networks ... to provide video services' and 'online services that offer Internet video streaming, downloading and distribution of movies, television shows and other video programming'; 'it is likely new technologies will further increase the number of competitors we face'

classification.quality_note: 'We are the largest cable operator in the United States' (FY2006 10-K, Item 1); 'We operate our businesses in an increasingly competitive environment' against DBS providers, phone companies 'that are building wireline fiber-optic networks ... to provide video services' and 'online services that offer Internet video streaming, downloading and distribution of movies, television shows and other video programming'; 'it is likely new technologies will further increase the number of competitors we face'. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.02x; -3% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.53; conservative 2yr +165%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -10.7%/yr (worst year FY04-FY06, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +24.0%/yr (Q3 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 4.0-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +46.4%/yr (FY04-FY06 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +46.4%/yr (best 2-yr run FY04-FY06); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: CMCSA (retrospective, 2008-01-04) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.02x (10.9% downside to Bear $15 / +458.2% upside to Bull $94) | Adj composite 2.75 vs market 1.22: gap +1.53 [UNDERVALUED] | -3% above the EPP floor $17 (29x FY07E $0.60) | Conservative 2-yr case: +165.2% total (+82.6%/yr) | At 28.1x FY07E the 15% hurdle price $22 sits at or below the BASE case; video subscribers +0.1% in Q3 2007, forward revenues +21% (no FY07 revenue guide in numbers, Q3 2007 revenue growth); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
